Taken together, the subdued June and July figures point to the energy-led inflation spike earlier in 2026 losing momentum, even as price levels have yet to return to the Federal Reserve's 2% annual target, according to CNBC. The BLS noted that the all-items index was unchanged in July before seasonal adjustment, bringing the index level to 333.918.

# CPI report shows inflation eased in July to a 3.4% annual pace

Updated on: August 12, 2026 / 2:20 PM EDT
/ CBS News

Inflation eased for the second consecutive month, rising at a 3.4% annual pace in July, in line with economists' expectations and a signal that some consumer price pressures may be easing.

## By the numbers

Economists polled by the financial data firm FactSet predicted July inflation rose at an annual rate of 3.4%.
